title: pv-dash selection file — the cache's fetch list
description: The selection file the modbus-cache --selection knob reads: WHICH device-profile entries the poller fetches into the cache (profile names only; everything else forwards live). The shipped example (extras/examples/modbus-cache-filter.json) is the essential SUN2000 monitoring set. The loader (cache/lib/config.py's load_selection) checks the names against the device profile at load — the schema cannot; a name not in the profile refuses with the name in the error. The loader also tolerates a bare name array (the object form is the blessed spelling) and ignores any extra keys; both tolerances are documented here, not blessed by the strict readers.

description.description: Free prose — what the set is for; the loader ignores it.

registers.description: The device-profile entry NAMES to fetch, in poll order; duplicates keep the profile's order anyway (a name not in the profile refuses at load).

oneOf.description: The tolerated bare-list form — the same list without the wrapper.
